model.need: Use the requiredHands already emitted by one to four digest-bound placement plans; require the actual edit-graph receipt whenever more than one plan is supplied; do not invent a hidden workflow.
model.spawn: Bind a known Hand implementation or recipe to the selected language organ, grammar profile, targets, environment, and authority gate.
model.hold: Missing source, implementation, verifier binding, tool, or usable host sandbox remains explicit instead of becoming a fake Hand.
model.authority: A spawned capability capsule is not permission to read, write, execute candidate code, install, deploy, or promote.
